faq.a: A PDF guide, a Google Sheet with a fair-split calculator and money-date log, and a Notion import with AI prompts.
The monthly money date is twenty minutes. The five conversations are each held once, properly, and revisited when something big changes.
Couples who share some or all of their money, including those supporting a parent, marrying later or planning around an inheritance.

faq.q: What if we already have separate accounts?
faq.a: That is one of the three models. The guide compares all three, including separate accounts plus shared bills, so you can choose the one you will both keep running.

faq.q: Can I print it or use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Both. Print the guide, or work from it on a tablet with any PDF app. The Google Sheet works in your browser.

faq.q: Is this financial, tax or legal advice?
faq.a: No. It is a conversation kit and general education only. Laws on inheritance and wills differ by state.
